questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a galvanic cell?
questions.solution: A galvanic cell converts chemical energy into electrical energy. A battery is a galvanic cell that provides electrical energy through spontaneous redox reactions. A resistor, switch, and capacitor do not involve chemical reactions to produce electricity.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन गैल्वेनिक सेल का उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: एक गैल्वेनिक सेल रासायनिक ऊर्जा को विद्युत ऊर्जा में बदलता है। एक बैटरी एक गैल्वेनिक सेल होती है जो स्वतः घटित ऑक्सीकरण-अपचयन अभिक्रियाओं द्वारा विद्युत ऊर्जा प्रदान करती है। प्रतिरोधक, स्विच और संधारित्र विद्युत को उत्पन्न करने के लिए रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं का उपयोग नहीं करते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as used in Hindi-medium science textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते गॅल्वॅनिक सेलचे उदाहरण आहे?

questions.stem: What is the standard electrode potential of the hydrogen electrode?
questions.solution: The standard electrode potential of the hydrogen electrode is defined as 0 V. This serves as a reference point for measuring other electrode potentials. The other values are incorrect.

questions.stem: What is the unit of molar conductivity?
questions.solution: The unit of molar conductivity is S·m²/mol. It represents the conductivity per mole of electrolyte. The other options are not the correct units for molar conductivity.

questions.stem: What is the main function of an electrochemical cell?
choices: To convert chemical energy into electrical energy
To convert mechanical energy into electrical energy
questions.solution: An electrochemical cell primarily functions by converting chemical energy into electrical energy through redox reactions. Storing electrical energy is more characteristic of a battery, converting heat into light is unrelated to electrochemical processes, and converting mechanical energy into electrical energy is the role of a generator.

questions.stem: What is the relationship between the standard electrode potential and the equilibrium constant of a reaction?
questions.solution: The standard electrode potential is directly proportional to the equilibrium constant of the reaction. This is given by the equation ΔG° = -nFE° and ΔG° = -RT ln K.

questions.stem: In a galvanic cell, the cell potential is the difference between the electrode potentials of the cathode and anode. If the standard electrode potential for zinc is -0.76 V and for copper is +0.34 V, what is the cell potential?
questions.solution: The cell potential is calculated as the potential of the cathode minus the potential of the anode. Since copper is the cathode and zinc is the anode, the cell potential is 0.34 V - (-0.76 V) = 1.10 V. The other options either subtract in the wrong order or fail to account for the negative value of the anode's potential.

hi.stem: गैल्वेनिक सेल में, सेल विभव धनात्मक और ऋणात्मक इलेक्ट्रोड के विभवों के अंतर के बराबर होता है। यदि जिंक के लिए मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव -0.76 V है और कॉपर के लिए +0.34 V है, तो सेल विभव क्या है?

questions.stem: What is the relationship between the Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) and the cell potential (E) of a galvanic cell?
questions.solution: The Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) is related to the cell potential (E) by the equation ΔG = -nFE. This relationship is derived from the principle that the maximum work done by a galvanic cell is equal to the decrease in Gibbs free energy. The option ΔG = nFE is incorrect because it does not account for the negative sign. The options ΔG = -E/nF and ΔG = E/nF are incorrect because they do not have the correct dependence on n, the number of moles of electrons transferred.

hi.stem: गैल्वेनिक सेल के जीब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन (ΔG) और सेल विभव (E) के बीच संबंध क्या है?
hi.solution: जीब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन (ΔG) सेल विभव (E) से समीकरण ΔG = -nFE द्वारा संबंधित है। इस संबंध की व्युत्पत्ति इस सिद्धांत से की गई है कि गैल्वेनिक सेल द्वारा किया गया अधिकतम कार्य जीब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा में कमी के बराबर होता है। विकल्प ΔG = nFE गलत है क्योंकि इसमें ऋणात्मक चिह्न की गणना नहीं की गई है। विकल्प ΔG = -E/nF और ΔG = E/nF गलत हैं क्योंकि इनमें n, इलेक्ट्रॉन के मोलों की संख्या के साथ सही निर्भरता नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate and maintains the technical terminology used in standard Hindi-medium textbooks. The meaning, options, and solution are all consistent with the English version.

mr.stem: गॅल्वॅनिक सेलच्या गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा बदलाचा (ΔG) आणि सेल विद्युत विभवाचा (E) संबंध काय आहे?
mr.solution: गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा बदल (ΔG) सेल विद्युत विभवाशी (E) असे संबंधित आहे की ΔG = -nFE. हा संबंध या तत्त्वावरून विकसित झाला आहे की गॅल्वॅनिक सेलद्वारे केलेले अधिकतम कार्य गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जेच्या घटीच्या बरोबरीत आहे. ΔG = nFE हा विकल्प चुकीचा आहे कारण त्यामध्ये ऋण चिन्हाचा विचार केलेला नाही. ΔG = -E/nF आणि ΔG = E/nF हे विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण ते n च्या वरील योग्य अवलंबित्वाचे नाहीत, जे विद्युत इलेक्ट्रॉनच्या मोलांच्या संख्येचे निरूपण करते.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terminology as used in Marathi textbooks.

distractorReason: confuses the sign of the relationship
Confuses the inverse relationship between cell potential and Gibbs free energy
incorrectly inverts the formula and ignores the sign of E
questions.critique: The correct relationship is ΔG = -nFE, which matches the author's key. The reasoning provided is sound and aligns with standard electrochemical principles.

questions.stem: If a galvanic cell is reversed by applying a higher external voltage, what type of cell does it become?
questions.solution: When a higher external voltage is applied to a galvanic cell, it reverses the spontaneous chemical reaction, causing it to function as an electrolytic cell, which requires an external voltage to drive a non-spontaneous reaction. Fuel cells and dry cells are types of galvanic cells that produce electricity through spontaneous reactions. Voltaic cells are another term for galvanic cells, which do not require external voltage to operate.

questions.stem: In the Daniell cell, what happens when the external voltage is less than 1.1 V?
choices: The reaction proceeds in the forward direction
The reaction proceeds in the reverse direction
No current flows through the cell
questions.solution: When the external voltage is less than 1.1 V, the cell potential is sufficient to drive the redox reaction in the forward direction, allowing current to flow. At 1.1 V, the cell reaches equilibrium and the reaction stops. If the voltage exceeds 1.1 V, the reaction is forced to proceed in the reverse direction. The correct option is that the reaction proceeds in the forward direction because the applied voltage is not enough to reverse the natural direction of the reaction.

mr.stem: दानिएल सेलमध्ये बाह्य विद्युताचे वोल्टेज 1.1 V पेक्षा कमी असताना काय होते?

questions.stem: In a concentration cell, the standard electrode potential is zero. However, the actual cell potential is non-zero. What explains this phenomenon?
choices: The concentrations of the anode and cathode are different
The temperature of the solution is different
The cell contains a different type of electrode
The cell is not properly connected
questions.solution: In a concentration cell, the standard electrode potential is zero because the same species are involved in both half-cells.
